responsibility: Provides the normal source-token instantiation point for the gccrs templated parser by explicitly instantiating `Parser<Lexer>`. In the Rust parsing subsystem this file ties the generic parser implementation in `rust-parse-impl.h` to the front end’s ordinary lexical token stream, so the compiler can build the standard item/statement/expression AST parser from a `Lexer` without keeping all template code header-only at every use site; it owns no distinct grammar itself, but it is the compilation unit that emits the parser specialization for regular Rust source parsing.
